title: `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` imports react-grid-layout's stylesheet at module scope — the last load-leg blocker, worth 2 entries not 1
body:
Filed by the `repo:objectui` execution seat (PM round 19, session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`) while accepting PR5383 (#5357). Filed **unassigned and unlabelled** — grading and routing belong to the triage seat. ⛔ Not a grading.

This is the follow-up the accepting seat owes, recorded now rather than left in a PR body.

## Why it is worth a card of its own

`pnpm check:node-esm-load` stands at **34 of 39** published ESM entries. After #5214 and #5357 cleared the entire extensionless-specifier class, the remaining 5 break down as:

| package | reason | ledger |
|---|---|---|
| `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` | imports `react-grid-layout`'s stylesheet at module scope; Node cannot load `.css` at all | `LOAD_DEBT` |
| `@object-ui/app-shell` | reaches that same stylesheet through **static** `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` imports in `DashboardView.tsx` and `ReportView.tsx` | `LOAD_DEBT` |
| `@object-ui/plugin-map` | imports `maplibre-gl`'s stylesheet; same question | `LOAD_DEBT` |
| `create-plugin` | bin-only CLI | not importable by design |
| `runner` | built web app | not importable by design |

**So this single change would clear two entries, not one** — `plugin-dashboard` and `app-shell` together, taking the load leg **34 → 36**. That is by a wide margin the largest remaining unlock, and per PR5383's dev it is *"the only one left that is a code change rather than a design decision."*

⚠️ The app-shell half was invisible until this week. While app-shell emitted extensionless specifiers its first error was `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` on its own file, which masked the `.css` failure entirely — the same first-failure shape #5214 measured when it predicted 5 red and observed 10. It only became legible once PR5383 removed the mask.

## The question, which is not obviously one shape

Node cannot evaluate a `.css` import at all, so this is not a spelling fix. Plausible directions, **not a recommendation** — the choice is the graders':

- Move the stylesheet import off module scope (a consumer-side `import` the host performs, or a documented CSS entry the package advertises rather than executes).
- Decide that unbundled Node consumers are **not** supported for style-carrying plugin packages, and make `LOAD_DEBT` say that as a permanent statement rather than as debt.
- Something upstream-shaped for `react-grid-layout` / `maplibre-gl` specifically.

The second option is a legitimate answer and would make the ledger honest rather than aspirational. ⚠️ Note it also settles `plugin-map`, so whichever way this goes it should be taken over the style-carrying packages as a group, not one at a time.

## Why `LOAD_DEBT` is the right place for these three today, and what it costs

`LOAD_DEBT` is deliberately kept separate from `SPECIFIER_DEBT` — its own header says merging them *"would let this gate become a grab-bag in which the defect it exists for stops being visible."* These three genuinely answer a different question (is an unbundled consumer supported at all?), so the entries are truthful.

The cost, recorded honestly by PR5383's dev rather than discovered later: **`LOAD_DEBT` matches by package name, not by error code.** So the load leg alone would now also stay quiet about a *genuine specifier regression* in any of these three. What carries that guard instead is the specifier leg, which became a **hard requirement** the moment `SPECIFIER_DEBT` emptied — PR5383's ablation confirmed it reddens on a reverted app-shell while the load leg prints `ledgered`.

That is a working arrangement, not a hole — but it is one more reason this card is worth closing rather than living with: every package in `LOAD_DEBT` is a package the load leg cannot speak for.

## Related

- **#5357** / PR5383 — cleared app-shell's specifiers and uncovered this; added the `LOAD_DEBT` entry
- **#5214** — the seven-package family, complete as of PR5383
- **#5382**, **#5367** — two separate blind spots in `check-node-esm-load.mjs`'s own parsing, both open
- **#5365** — extensionless re-exports in `@object-ui/components` (21) and `@object-ui/layout` (7) `.d.ts` emits, the blocker on any downstream `nodenext` pin
